Target Corporation is a major American retail chain operating both physical stores and a large e-commerce platform, investing heavily in AI-driven search and personalization. Strong Python and SQL foundation with hands-on production experience in PyTorch, AWS SageMaker, and Databricks. Targets Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer, and Applied Scientist roles. My "Patient Readmission Risk Predictor" project (Python, XGBoost, scikit-learn, SQL, SHAP, Pandas; Healthcare) is the closest match to this role's day-to-day work. The requirements I can evidence directly from my resume and portfolio are Embeddings, GenAI/RAG systems, retrieval and ranking models, NLP.
